title: Async session scan at startup
intent: GREEN: targeted tests for lazy session ledger, candidate-only recovery read, session_load phase
progress_summary: Implemented: wizard session ledger loads on a background thread (joined on first read); startup recovery reads only placeholder/fresh/update-resume candidates and defers the rest to the blocking worker; worktree inventory no longer parses sessions (unused session_ids removed); perf.startup gains session_load phase with count.
